svg.text: The Filters dock: one Filter card, here with only Channel. The gear button opens Configure Filters.
Columns side by side: how many columns of the card sit next to each other (1 to 4).
Name: tick a field to put it on the card; the number is how many distinct values it has now.
Priority: the position of the column on the card.
Shown as: Checkbox list, Multi-select or Range (min..max).
Default: add the column to every new graph's card on top of Channel.
Auto apply: show each change on the graph in focus while you make it; Cancel restores the card.
